name: Torture rack
description: A long timber rack on four braced legs with a plank bed: a roller across each end wound with rope, the ropes running along the bed to wrist and ankle loops, capstan bars through the head roller and a toothed iron ratchet wheel and pawl on the foot roller.

provenance.prompt: A timber rack with rollers, ropes and a ratchet wheel, about 2.4 × 1 × 1 m.
